value.rationale: Lie complexity is a standard structural invariant: it counts whole cyclic conjugacy classes realized within a factor language, not a manufactured statistic. This is an all-length complete formula for a central non-Sturmian automatic word omitted from the original detailed examples, including a sharp classification of supported lengths as exactly the binary regular language 10* union 110* and an elementary length-halving mechanism. It is not a finite table, routine parameter substitution, or narrow arbitrary slice.
